properties.entry: SELECT ccl_id_cod_origen FROM income.tarea_localizacion_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY ccl_id_cod_origen, id_tarea, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT cod_tipo_hora FROM income.tarea_tipo_hora WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY cod_tipo_hora HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income.tarea_persona_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income.tarea_localizacion_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income.tarea_persona_estructura WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income.tarea_localizacion_presencia WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea AND ccl_id_seccion != :idSeccion
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income.tarea_localizacion_persona_presencia WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea AND ccl_id_seccion != :idSeccion
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income.tarea_localizacion_venta WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea AND ccl_id_seccion != :idSeccion

SELECT * FROM income.tarea_persona_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea AND ((std_id_hr IS NULL OR std_id_hr = '') OR (ccl_id_person IS NULL OR ccl_id_person = '') OR (ccl_id_cod_origen IS NULL OR ccl_id_cod_origen = '') OR (std_id_work_locat IS NULL OR std_id_work_locat = '') OR (fecha_fin IS NULL ) OR (fecha_inicio IS NULL ) OR (std_or_hr_period IS NULL OR std_or_hr_period = '') OR (id_tarea IS NULL ))

WITH tablas AS (SELECT std_id_work_locat AS localizacion, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM income.tarea_ambito_localizacion WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY std_id_work_locat UNION ALL SELECT std_id_work_locat AS localizacion, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM income.tarea_localizacion_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY std_id_work_locat) SELECT localizacion, row_count FROM tablas GROUP BY localizacion, row_count HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2

WITH tablas AS (SELECT ccl_id_person AS name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM income.tarea_ambito_persona WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY ccl_id_person UNION ALL SELECT ccl_id_person AS name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM income.tarea_persona_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY ccl_id_person) SELECT name, row_count FROM tablas GROUP BY name, row_count HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2

WITH tablas AS (SELECT std_id_leg_ent AS name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM income.tarea_localizacion_historico WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY std_id_leg_ent UNION ALL SELECT std_id_leg_ent AS name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM income.tarea WHERE id_tarea = :idTarea GROUP BY std_id_leg_ent) SELECT name FROM tablas GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2
